project.name: mio
project.tagline: 一个自然语言驱动的浏览器 Agent（Chrome 扩展）——告诉它你想做什么，mio 会替你点击、输入、滚动、导航、提取内容。
project.description: Natural-language browser agent as a Chrome extension: zero dependencies, local-first, free. Tell it what to do and it clicks, types, scrolls, navigates and extracts content for you.
features: Natural-language browser automation: tell it what to do, it operates the page
Zero dependencies: no Node, no Python, no backend — one Chrome extension
Local-first: your LLM API key stays in chrome.storage, data never leaves your machine
Any OpenAI-compatible LLM, including local models (Ollama etc.)
competitors: Playwright scripts: need Node + code, break when the site changes
Cloud browser agents: data leaves your machine, paid subscriptions
